name: TPT Email Provider Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Windows SMTP/IMAP email server with REST API and dashboard; no software license fee, vendor-imposed message quota or expiration documented.
watch_out: Requires Windows 10/11 or Windows Server, Node.js 20+, self-managed infrastructure, static IP, business-grade connectivity and reverse DNS for deliverability. ISP port restrictions, IP reputation, domain, storage and operations may incur costs. No free hosted email delivery or infrastructure is included; production security and deliverability require independent assessment.
